parameters.prompt: A plush toy horse head made of modeling clay, in a stop-motion claymation style: a chunky, rounded, cuddly brown horse head with a cream muzzle, a short black yarn mane, two round button eyes and a soft stitched seam, cut off neatly at the neck like a stuffed toy.
